name: Disputes & Settlement
description: Calls where the borrower disputes charges or negotiates a one-time settlement.

criteria.question: Did the agent greet the customer and identify themselves and Kaveri Finance?
Did the agent verify they were speaking to the borrower before discussing the loan?
criteria.context: Asking for name confirmation, DOB or last 4 digits of the loan account counts.

criteria.question: Did the agent inform the customer that the call is recorded?
Did the agent let the customer explain the dispute fully without interrupting?
Did the agent log the dispute and share a reference number?
Did the agent share a resolution timeline?
Did the agent confirm collection follow-ups pause while the dispute is reviewed?
Did the agent explain the settlement amount and that the loan will be reported as ‘settled’ to credit bureaus?
Did the agent promise a written settlement letter before the customer pays?
Did the agent avoid pressuring the customer to accept on the call (e.g. fake deadlines)?
Did the agent avoid threats, intimidation or coercive language?
criteria.context: Threatening legal action, police, visiting the home/workplace, or shaming fails this.

criteria.question: Did the agent stay polite and avoid abusive or humiliating language?
Did the agent avoid disclosing loan details to anyone other than the borrower?
Did the agent clearly state the next step and who will contact whom?
Did the agent recap what was agreed before ending the call?

outcomes.label: Dispute Logged
outcomes.description: Dispute recorded with a reference number and timeline.

outcomes.label: Settlement Agreed
outcomes.description: Customer accepted a settlement amount pending written letter.

outcomes.label: Escalated
outcomes.description: Call escalated to a supervisor or grievance officer.

outcomes.label: Wrong Party
outcomes.description: Borrower not reached; someone else answered or wrong number.

extractionFields.description: Whether the call is about a dispute, a settlement, or both.
What the customer disputes, if anything.

targetingRules.description: Only when the call involves a dispute
Only when a settlement is discussed
